questions.answer: Felt like they where a little behind compered to UCPH

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
The lectures where recorded, and the turn up to the lectures by students are poor. This clearly effect the style and quality of teaching. 
There are many small assignment during the semester that is a part of the overall grade, so you need to work though the semester aswell, and not only up to exams

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *

questions.answer:
CHEM3121	Chemical Biology
CHEM3122	Molecular Self Assembly
CHEM3123	Computational Chemistry
EDUH4058	Sport and Learning in Australian Culture

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
EDUH4058	Sport and Learning in Australian Culture: a really fun and easy unit where you attent rugby matches and other sport event in Sydney 

The CHEM studies were all good, but they take a lot of time. Only take them that matche your field of study/interest

What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Consider buying a car, the public transport sucks 
If you live at QMB you can change your dates if you write them before so they matches your dates 
If you want to play football, rugby or other sport during your exchange, write the uni the semester before so you can be signed up before it closes
